mappings.note: This verse contains introductory text ('Jeune homme, réjouis-toi...') and a command to 'remove sorrow' which is not present in the OSMAIN text. The OSMAIN text begins directly with 'Husk din Skaper' (Remember your Creator).

This verse ('Ôte le chagrin...') continues the introductory theme not found in OSMAIN. It is likely a translation of Ecclesiastes 12:1a or an interpolation from other traditions, but has no counterpart in the provided OSMAIN text.

extraContent.description: The entire verse is extra content not found in OSMAIN. It contains the exhortation 'Jeune homme, réjouis-toi en ton jeune âge...' (Young man, rejoice in your youth...) and 'Ôte le chagrin de ton cœur' (Remove sorrow from your heart). The OSMAIN text starts directly at verse 3 of this translation's sequence with 'Remember your Creator'. This suggests the Martin translation includes Ecclesiastes 12:1a or a different textual tradition for the opening, which is missing in the provided OSMAIN master text.

The entire verse is extra content not found in OSMAIN. It reads 'Ôte le chagrin de ton cœur, et éloigne de toi le mal; car le jeune âge et l'adolescence ne sont que vanité.' (Remove sorrow from your heart... for youth and adolescence are but vanity). This text does not appear in the provided OSMAIN verses.
